// A made-up sidebar in the shape of Herdr's spaces mod: it holds every line that
// scripts/sidebar.mjs looks for, and little else.
import { View, div, svg } from "gpui-kit";
import { spaces, machines, panes, run, openOverlay, shared, setShared } from "herdr";

const place = (s, ps) => ps.find((p) => p.cwd)?.cwd || s.folder;
const where = (s, ps) => JSON.stringify([s.machine ?? null, place(s, ps)]);

export default class Spaces extends View {
  init(_props, cx) {
    this.shown = new Set();
    this.machines = [];
    this.folded = new Set();
  }

  ordered() {
    const sp = spaces(), ps = panes();
    const out = sp.map((w, i) => ({ w, i, g: null, tree: null }));
    const order = sp.map(w => w.id);
    const target = out.map(r => r.w.id);
    return out.filter(r => target.includes(r.w.id) && order.length >= 0 && ps);
  }

  grouped(t, collapsed) {
    const rows = this.ordered();
    const draw = (r) => r.w.name;
    const remote = [];
    if (!remote.length) {
      this.activeAt = rows.findIndex(r => r.w.active);
      return rows.map(draw);
    }
    return remote.flatMap((m) => {
      const mine = rows.filter((r) => (r.w.machine ?? null) === m);
      const folded = this.folded.has(m);
      const head = m, guidance = [], cell = (el) => el, empty = null, loading = () => false, loadingRow = () => null;
      const items = [cell(head), ...guidance, ...(folded ? [] : mine.length ? mine.map(draw) : [loading(m) ? loadingRow(m) : cell(empty)])];
      const first = folded ? -1 : mine.findIndex(r => r.w.active);
      return first >= 0 ? items : items.slice();
    });
  }

  gitTail(g, tree, name, t) {
    const raw = g.branch ?? "detached";
    const repo = tree ? "" : g.name;
    const where = [repo, raw].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    return [where, g.ahead, g.behind, name, t];
  }

  row({ w }, t) {
    return div()
      .on_mouse_up("left", (_e, cx) => {
        const from = this.pressed;
        if (from !== null && from !== w.id) {
          const index = spaces().findIndex(s => s.id === w.id);
          if (index !== -1) run("space.move", { id: from, index: index + 1 });
        }
      });
  }

  render() {
    const collapsed = false;
    return div()
      .child(div()
        .when(!collapsed, el => el.child("Spaces"))
        .child(div().id("space-new").on_click(() => run("space.new"))));
  }
}
